title: La Guitarra de Paracho, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: guitarra-paracho (MAJESTIC): fábrica de guitarras y casa humilde en Paracho, Michoacán. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.EFRAIN_CHAVEZ: Mexican man from Michoacán, young luthier, 24 years old, light-brown skin, curly black hair, light stubble, a grey t-shirt under a denim work apron with sawdust, jeans, work boots, his hands empty.
chars.RICARDO_CUEVAS: Mexican man, 30 years old, light skin, slicked-back black hair, a thin goatee, dark sunglasses on his head, a white linen shirt open at the chest, a gold chain, beige trousers, white loafers, his hands empty.
chars.GILBERTO_CUEVAS: Mexican boss from Michoacán, 62 years old, heavy-set, light-brown skin, grey hair, a thick grey mustache, a black felt cowboy hat, a burgundy western shirt, a big silver belt buckle, dark jeans, black boots, his hands empty.
chars.JOSEFINA_CHAVEZ: Mexican mother from Michoacán, 55 years old, brown skin, black hair with grey strands in a low bun, a dark-green shawl over a white blouse, a checked apron, a long dark skirt, her hands empty.
